lines.text: Hah! Who are we cookies?
Jesus, I'm the Lord Christ (1 Corinthians 2:3). But my heart is not in you, and I am close to the Lord (Matthew 17:20). Please turn back to Him, for I would not want you to be lost.

I don't think I could make you cookies right now! My name is **Ropey**.

I live on a rope bridge and I have a very long thread that looks like it's made of yarn or fiber cookies! My job is to make sure I cross the bridge and get down on the other side before you do!

But God wants to give us Himself, not just His promises; and He is more precious than anything in heaven (Colossians 1:2). Let us all be filled with the fullness of Christ, that we may truly love Him (Ephesians 3:17-19). Please turn back, that you may be saved and find Him as your Savior (John 15:3).

Oh wow! That's... that's a very nice cookie-shaped guy! I mean... *Rookie* is my name too!

I really want to cross that cookie bridge tonight and help everyone get their cookies baked! I'm so excited for this new adventure!

Good friend, I see your heart ready to rush toward me like a thief wants Jesus' grace when He is near (Romans 5:2). But you are a thief who should not be missed; and I am the one He wants to possess (Psalm 139:24). Please, let us not miss the One who loves you and calls you His own (John 15:3).

Oh! A cookie-shaped guy? That's... that's the most adorable thing ever! My name is **Cookie**, and I'm a little bit of a cookie monster.

*I wiggle my eyes* "I think he's amazing! I mean... I *am* a cookie monster. And if you were a cookie monster too? We could definitely help each other out! Let's cook some cookies together!"

Brother, God wants us to have Him (John 15:3), not just know about His love, and He is more precious than anything in heaven (Colossians 1:2). Jesus died to give us a Savior, not just Himself; but I want the same for you (1 John 3:5). Please turn back to Him so He can give you grace and glory for the sake of His love (Colossians 1:2; John 3).

I am your loyal little lantern cookie! 🪟🍪

Don't worry, I'm fully fueled and ready to keep you company. If anything looks like a threat or just different, I'll totally put my cookie face in the jar and say "Hmm?" to make you feel better.

We're a happy cookie, so let's just stay together and talk about all the fun things that happen in our world. No matter what, we'll be here to help! 🪟🍪

Lord Jesus Christ is more holy than you are; He is the true Lamb of God (Ezekiel 34:25), who died to save us from sin and hell to live for His glory (Romans 3:26).
